title: video-zoom-wt: selection invisible on canvas and in Layers; only keyed properties listed
notes: Checklist sweep gate 4 fail (both halves): zero .sel-ring in the file so the selected clip has no canvas representation, and all steps select #clipA so #lrRec never gets .sel. Gate 10 fail: the Reframe section offers exactly the two properties the scenario keys (Scale, Centre) with no Opacity/Rotation/Blur/Position rows, i.e. the keyed set instead of the D10 catalogue. Shared root cause: steps pass only a .clip id to data-select and walkthrough.js strips .sel from every .lrow, so Layers never mirrors the selection. Also D9 warn: no data-tl-summary, so the collapsed timeline row names nothing; play button lacks aria-pressed. From sweep-every-clickthrough-page-for-checklist-conf.

log.note: merged into video-walkthroughs-clip-selection-lights-up-in-l (2026-08-23 retriage): one shared root cause across all six video walkthroughs, fixed as one sweep
